<!--
Nothing enforces that box. It replaced a required approving review, so it is
the only review gate this repository has -- ticking it without having run the
review removes the gate entirely rather than working around it.

Worth saying what the box does and does not mean: /code-review reads the diff
and reasons about it. It catches real defects, and it also raises findings that
are wrong, out of scope, or restatements of a tradeoff the PR already made.
"Addressed or consciously accepted" is the standard -- not "zero findings".
A finding you disagree with, noted in the PR with a reason, satisfies this.
